bio.text: LaKesha Womack is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina's 14th Congressional District in 2026, running against Republican Rep. Tim Moore.
WFAE's voter guide lists her as 47 years old, with no prior elected office, and chief strategy officer of Aspire Community Capital.
According to the guide, she grew up in Alabama and holds bachelor's and master's degrees from Vanderbilt University.

sources.title: U.S. House of Representatives NC-14 Candidates
